# Ezekiel 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** "And-you, son-of man, thus says the-Lord YHWH to-the-land-of Israel: An-end! The-end has-come upon the-four corners-of the-land.

**3** Now [is] the-end upon-you, and-I-will-send My-anger against-you, and-I-will-judge-you according-to your-ways, and-I-will-bring upon-you all your-abominations.

**4** And-My-eye shall-not-spare you, and-I-will-not-have-pity; for your-ways upon-you I-will-bring, and-your-abominations shall-be in-your-midst, and-you-shall-know that I [am] YHWH."

**5** Thus says the-Lord YHWH: "An-evil! A-singular evil — behold, it-comes!

**6** An-end has-come! The-end has-come! It-has-awakened against-you — behold, it-comes!

**7** The-doom has-come to-you, O-inhabitant-of the-land! The-time has-come, the-day [is] near — tumult and-not joyful-shouting on-the-mountains.

**8** Now, shortly I-will-pour-out My-fury upon-you, and-I-will-spend My-anger against-you, and-I-will-judge-you according-to your-ways, and-I-will-bring upon-you all your-abominations.

**9** And-My-eye shall-not-spare, and-I-will-not-have-pity; according-to your-ways upon-you I-will-bring, and-your-abominations shall-be in-your-midst; and-you-shall-know that I [am] YHWH, the-one-striking.

**10** Behold the-day! Behold it-comes! The-doom has-gone-forth, the-rod has-blossomed, the-arrogance has-budded.

**11** Behold the-day! Behold it-comes! The-doom has-gone-forth, the-rod has-blossomed, the-arrogance has-budded.

**12** Behold the-day! Behold it-comes! The-doom has-gone-forth, the-rod has-blossomed, the-arrogance has-budded.

**13** For the-seller shall-not-return to what-was-sold while-yet in-the-living their-life, for the-vision [is] against all her-multitude — it-shall-not-return; and-no-man in-his-iniquity shall-strengthen his-life.

**14** They-have-blown the-trumpet and-prepared everything, but-none goes to the-battle, for My-fury [is] against all her-multitude.

**15** The-sword [is] outside, and-the-pestilence and-the-famine inside; the-one who [is] in-the-field by-the-sword shall-die, and-the-one who [is] in-the-city — famine and-pestilence shall-devour-him.

**16** And-their-escapees shall-escape and-be upon-the-mountains like-doves-of the-valleys, all-of-them moaning — each in-his-iniquity.

**17** And-their-escapees shall-escape and-be upon-the-mountains like-doves-of the-valleys, all-of-them moaning — each in-his-iniquity.

**18** And-their-escapees shall-escape and-be upon-the-mountains like-doves-of the-valleys, all-of-them moaning — each in-his-iniquity.

**19** And-their-escapees shall-escape and-be upon-the-mountains like-doves-of the-valleys, all-of-them moaning — each in-his-iniquity.

**20** And-the-beauty-of his-ornament — for-majesty he-set-it; and-images-of their-abominations, their-detestable-things, they-made in-it; therefore I-have-made-it to-them an-unclean-thing.

**21** And-I-will-give-it into-the-hand-of the-strangers for-plunder, and-to-the-wicked-of the-earth for-spoil, and-they-shall-profane-it.

**22** And-I-will-turn My-face from-them, and-they-shall-profane My-treasured-place; and-violent-ones shall-enter-it and-profane-it.

**23** Make the-chain! For the-land is-full-of judgments-of blood, and-the-city is-full-of violence.

**24** And-I-will-bring the-worst-of the-nations, and-they-shall-possess their-houses; and-I-will-put-an-end-to the-pride-of the-strong, and-their-holy-places shall-be-profaned.

**25** Anguish comes! And-they-shall-seek peace, and-there-is-none.

**26** Disaster upon disaster shall-come, and-rumor upon rumor; and-they-shall-seek a-vision from-the-prophet, and-torah shall-perish from-the-priest, and-counsel from-the-elders.

**27** The-king shall-mourn, and-the-prince shall-be-clothed-with desolation, and-the-hands-of the-people-of the-land shall-tremble. According-to their-way I-will-do to-them, and-with-their-judgments I-will-judge-them; and-they-shall-know that I [am] YHWH."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **7:2**: Qetz! Ba ha-qetz — 'An end! The end has come.' The staccato repetition mimics the breathless urgency of the announcement. Cf. Amos 8:2 where qetz puns on qayits (summer fruit).

- **7:23**: Aseh et-ha-rattoq — 'make the chain!' A command to forge chains of captivity. The land filled with mishpetei damim (bloody judgments/crimes) receives chains as divine sentence.

- **7:26**: Torah from priest, vision from prophet, counsel from elders — the three pillars of guidance all fail simultaneously. Israel's entire knowledge system collapses.

— EMET
